info.name: Petstore Generated Cases - Manual Validation
info.description: Generated from the approved 43-case plan, revision 1. Review each request description before sending. The default target is the loopback mock at 127.0.0.1:4010/v2. That mock implements only GET /store/inventory, POST /store/order, and GET /store/order/{orderId}; other routes return 404 and are not validated by it. Do not point mutating requests at public Petstore. OAuth credentials and live test data are not included. Mutating requests are guarded to the loopback mock; the session-logout request is blocked pending manual review.
